data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'Nore', meaning 'light' or 'bright'. The name Norene has been used throughout history for those who bring light and hope to others. The name Norene carries the meaning “Light, Bright One” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Norene usually hope their child will grow to embody light, bright one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Norene total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

This name has travelled through time, reaching various parts of the world and carrying with it the significance of illumination and hope. Norene is a beacon of light, not just for her own life but also for those around her.
data.spiritual_significance: Norene is a name that holds a deep spiritual significance, drawing its meaning from the Greek language that translates to 'light'. In a spiritual sense, Norene represents the Light of the World, a reference to Jesus Christ, who came to bring light and life to the world. As a Christian name, Norene is a reminder of the spiritual journey towards enlightenment and the eternal light of God's love.
